_comment_schema: Synthflow agent export — schema is best-effort: Synthflow not available in context7 as of 2026-05-20; structure mirrors agents/loodgieter.v1.json. Verify against current Synthflow console export before first prod deploy.
_comment_source_prompt: System prompt master copy lives at klantkraan/packages/prompts/en/airco.v1.md — pasted verbatim at render time; the .rendered.md (after mustache fill) is what gets deployed, and its SHA-256 is logged per call.
name: klantkraan-airco-en-v1

voice._comment_voice: TODO: replace with an ElevenLabs English voice id (neutral British/European English, clear and calm). Not a US-broadcast style. Resolve during onboarding; store the choice on the client's Attio record.

model.name: claude-sonnet-4-6
model._comment_model: Matches the Dutch agents; Synthflow's supported list as of 2026-05. Founder picks the model in agent settings; the prompt is model-agnostic.

first_message: Hello, you're speaking with {{agent_naam}}, the digital assistant at {{client_name}}. This call is handled by an AI system and may be recorded for quality and training purposes. If you'd rather speak with a person, just say 'agent'. How can I help you?
_comment_first_message: English counterpart of the verbatim disclosure in klantkraan/docs/04-legal/ai-act-disclosure.md. Non-waivable per MSA. Before first deploy, add this English text to that legal doc so CI drift-checks have a source of truth.
system_prompt: PLACEHOLDER — at deploy time, the n8n client-onboarding.json workflow reads packages/prompts/en/airco.v1.md, runs mustache substitution with the per-client variables resolved from Attio, writes the result to packages/prompts/en/airco.{client_id}.rendered.md, computes SHA-256, then PUTs the rendered content into this field via the Synthflow API.

tools.name: schedule_callback
tools.description: Log a callback request for the owner. Use when the caller is NEW_JOB or EXISTING_CUSTOMER. Never schedule an actual calendar appointment without explicit caller confirmation of date + time.

tools.name: transfer_emergency
tools.description: Transfer the caller straight to the owner on an EMERGENCY (no cooling for a vulnerable person, water leak onto electrics, burning smell/electrical fault, refrigerant leak, gas smell). Transfer first; only collect extra details if the transfer fails.

tools.name: lookup_tariff
tools.description: Fetch the client's rate context (call-out fee, service price, recharge, install survey) and give a short spoken summary. May only be called when may_quote_prices = true.

webhooks._comment_webhook: POST JSON: {intent, caller_name, caller_phone, town, summary, next_action, priority, audio_url, transcript, duration_s, prompt_hash, model, voice_id, disclosure_played_at_ms}. See apps/api route in klantkraan/docs/08-tech/repo-architecture.md.

compliance._comment_compliance: AI Act art. 50 in force 2 Aug 2026; disclosure is non-waivable per MSA; logged via compliance_audits table; founder spot-checks 10 random calls/month per 04-legal/ai-act-disclosure.md.

fallback.on_unintelligible_prompt_en: I'm sorry, I can't hear you well. I'll ask {{owner_naam}} to call you back.
fallback.on_call_duration_exceeded_prompt_en: To be thorough, I'll have {{owner_naam}} call you back personally. He'll have your details within 4 hours.
